citation.paper: Alam et al. 2017, MNRAS 470, 2617, The clustering of galaxies in the completed SDSS-III BOSS: cosmological analysis of the DR12 galaxy sample

measurements_BAO_only_consensus.covariance_note: 6x6, total (stat+sys), in the same row order and units as the values (Mpc and km/s/Mpc, rd/rd_fid factors omitted). sqrt(624.707)=25.0 matches 22 and 11 added in quadrature (24.6) to print rounding.

fiducial.note: Neff and neutrino mass are in the paper's Section 2.2 but were not transcribed; request them from the PDF if a leg needs them.

printed_flat_LCDM_Om_BAO_only: NOT FOUND as a clean BAO-only number; the paper prints Om=0.310±0.005 for Planck+BAO+FS (flat LCDM), and Planck alone 0.317±0.009. Leg O3's BAO-only Om stays NOT RUN unless a source is named.
terms: SDSS public data: the SDSS 'How to Cite SDSS' page (sdss4.org/collaboration/citing-sdss/) asks users of public SDSS data to cite the survey papers; no licence text read beyond that. Use: derived numbers and short fixtures with citation.
